title: Kind words from people we've worked with.
tickerLabel: Some of the teams we've worked with

items.quote: Orbe didn't just ship an app — they changed how our product team works. Account openings doubled in the first quarter.
items.name: Camille Arnaud

items.quote: They understood our archive better than we did. The new collection site made our photographs feel alive again.
items.name: Jonas Weber

items.quote: Eight weeks, zero drama, and a store our customers keep complimenting. I'd hire them again tomorrow.
items.name: Leïla Benali

items.quote: A rare mix of poetry and pragmatism. The trip planner is now our most-visited page by far.
items.name: Ingrid Solberg

items.quote: Their designers sat with our dispatchers for a week. You can feel that care in every screen.
items.name: Marco Ruiz
